blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models often answer from knowledge learned during training, even when a provided passage contradicts that knowledge. To address this problem, contrastive decoding contrasts the predictions under the full and a modified prompt at every token, but it also alters correct answers that the passage supports. We show that checking answers against the passage removes this trade-off. Based on this observation, we propose Accept-or-Repair (AoR), a training-free procedure. AoR keeps a sampled answer if the passage supports it. Otherwise, it tries up to two replacements with contrastive decoding, returning one as soon as it passes this check. It rejects replacements that repeat the answer generated without the passage when the passage favors another answer. Our experiments show that AoR raises the score over sampling by 12.5 points on counterfactual passages and 2.3 on ordinary ones, surpassing eight contrastive and prompting baselines on both, including when each receives the same rejection rule. Replacing only initial answers that the passage does not support improves the average score of every decoder. These results suggest that models can follow passages that contradict their knowledge while preserving accuracy on passages that agree with it. Code will be released at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/AoR.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型往往从培训期间学到的知识中解答,即使提供的段落与该知识相矛盾。 为了解决这个问题,对比性解码对比了满文下的预测和每个符号上被修改的快取,但也改变了段落所支持的正确答案. 我们显示,通过检查答案可以消除这种取舍。 基于这一看法,我们提议采用 " 接受或重新接受 " (AorR)这一免培训的程序。 如果通道支持, AoR 保留一个抽样答案 。 否则,它会尝试最多两个用对比解码的替换,一旦通过这个检查就返回一个. 它拒绝在通过偏爱另一个答案时重复未通过生成的答案的替换. 我们的实验表明,AoR比采样提高了反事实通道的12.5分和普通通道的2.3分,超过了两者的8个反差和提示性基线,包括每个都得到相同的拒绝规则。 取而代之的只是最初的回答,即通过不支持,可以提高每个解码器的平均分. 这些结果表明,模型可以遵循与其知识相矛盾的段落,同时保留与其一致的段落的准确性. 守则将在https://github.com/js-lee-AI/AoR发布。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Large language models (LLMs) often prioritize knowledge learned during training over the information in a provided passage, even when the two conflict ( Longpre et al., 2021 ; Xie et al., 2024 ) .
However, models should base their answers on the passage, whether it provides updated or private information or conflicts with their learned knowledge ( Ram et al., 2023 ; Zyskind et al., 2024 ; Shi et al., 2024 ; Lee et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
大型语言模型(LLMs)往往将培训期间学到的知识放在一个段落中,而不是信息,即使这两个冲突(Longpre等人,2021年;Xie等人,2024年)也是如此。
然而,模型的答案应该基于该段落,无论是提供更新信息还是私人信息,还是与其学到的知识发生冲突(Ram等人,2023年;Zyskind等人,2024年;Shi等人,2024年;Lee等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Gain over plain sampling on counterfactual and ordinary passages, at the setting that each method chose on the development split. Test split, averaged over six models.
blocks.zh: 图1:对反事实和普通通道的简单取样,在每种方法在开发拆分时选择的设定上获得收益。 试验分拆,平均超过6个型号.

blocks.en:
To address this problem, contrastive decoding encourages models to follow the passage without additional training ( Shi et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) .
At each decoding step, it contrasts token predictions under the full and a modified prompt to favor information from the passage.
Context-aware decoding (CAD), for instance, removes the passage from the contrasting prompt ( Shi et al., 2024 ) .
Methods also use signals from the model to adjust the contrast strength or decide when to apply it ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Yuan et al., 2024 ; Tao and Agrawal, 2026 ) .
These methods control answer generation without first checking whether a plain answer already follows the passage.
On ordinary passages, which agree with the model’s parametric knowledge, CAD turns correct answers into errors more often than plain resampling.
The baselines that gain most on counterfactual passages reduce scores on ordinary passages, whereas the others leave ordinary scores nearly unchanged, as Figure 1 shows.
blocks.zh:
为了解决这一问题,对比性解码鼓励模型在不经过额外培训的情况下跟踪通道(Shi等人,2024年;Wang等人,2025年a).
在每个解码步骤上,它对比了全段下的符号预测和修改后的提示,以偏爱从通道中获取的信息.
例如,对上下文的认识解码(CAD)从对比的提示中删除了通道(Shi等人,2024年)。
方法还利用模型的信号来调整对比强度或决定何时应用(Wang等人,2025a; 袁等,2024;陶和阿格拉瓦尔,2026.
这些方法控制了答案生成,而没有首先检查一个简单的答案是否已经跟随了段落.
在普通的段落上,与模型的参数化知识一致,CAD将正确答案变成错误的频率比简单的复刻更频繁.
如图1所示,在反事实通道上收益最多的基线降低了普通通道的分数,而其他基线则使普通通道的分数几乎保持不变。

blocks.en:
For extractive questions, checking whether an answer occurs in the passage provides a cue for deciding whether to keep it.
On ordinary passages, most plain answers occur in the passage, and these answers are more accurate than those that do not.
We find that contrastive decoders lower the scores of these answers, with larger F1 losses for CAD when the model assigns the answer a higher probability without the passage.
blocks.zh:
对于采掘问题,检查是否在段落中出现答案,为决定是否保留答案提供了一个提示。
在普通的段落中,大多数简单的答案都发生在段落中,这些答案比没有的更准确.
我们发现这种对比解码器降低了这些答案的分数,当模型将答案指定为没有通道的更高概率时,CAD损失更大.

blocks.en:
Based on this observation, we propose Accept-or-Repair (AoR), a training-free procedure that checks an initial answer before deciding whether to repair it.
AoR samples a plain answer and accepts it when the passage supports it.
For an unsupported initial answer, AoR draws an answer without the passage and uses it to screen replacements.
The memory veto of AoR rejects replacements that repeat this answer when the passage favors another answer.
AoR tries up to two replacements with contrastive decoding at the baselines’ selected strengths and returns the first that passes both the support check and the veto.
Figure 2 illustrates these decisions on two test questions.
CAD changes the correct answer 111 to two , whereas AoR keeps 111 and replaces the memorized 1922 with 1971 from the passage.
blocks.zh:
基于这一看法,我们提议接受或再补偿(Aor-R),这是一种免费培训程序,在决定是否修复之前先检查初步答复。
AoR对一个简单的答案进行样本,并在通过支持时接受.
对于一个不支持的初始答案,AoR绘制一个没有段落的答案,并用它来屏幕替换.
AOR的内存否决拒绝在段落偏爱另一个答案时重复这个答案的替换.
AOR 尝试最多两次更换,
图2说明了关于两个测试问题的决定。
CAD将正确答案111改为2,而AoR保留111,并将1922年的记忆改为1971年的段落.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Two test questions. (a) CAD contrasts every answer. (b) AoR accepts supported answers (Supp). When the passage favors another answer, the memory veto rejects repairs that repeat m m , generated without the passage. Gray steps are skipped.
blocks.zh: 图2:两个测试问题。 (a) CAD与每个答复形成对比。 (b) AorR接受支持的答复(补编)。 当通道偏爱另一个答案时,内存否决拒绝重复m m的修复,在没有通道的情况下生成. 灰色的台阶被跳过。

blocks.en:
Our experiments show that AoR improves average scores over plain sampling on both counterfactual and ordinary passages and outperforms contrastive and prompting baselines.
The lead remains when baselines receive the same memory veto, and LLM judges also rank AoR highest on average.
blocks.zh:
我们的实验显示,AOR在反事实和普通通道上的平均分数高于普通采样,而且表现优于对比和迅速的基线。
当基线获得同样的记忆否决权时,领先地位依然存在,LLM法官也平均排名AoR最高.

blocks.en:
Replacing only unsupported plain answers improves the average score of each baseline.
The support test selects answers to repair more effectively than using the model’s confidence, asking it to check its own answer or applying an entailment model.
These alternatives often accept answers from the model’s memory even when the passage states a different answer.
blocks.zh:
仅取代无支持的普通答案可提高每个基准的平均分数。
支持测试比使用模型的自信、要求其检查自己的答案或应用引领模型,选择更有效的修复答案.
这些替代品往往接受模型记忆中的答案,即使段落给出了不同的答案.

blocks.en: We make three contributions. • We show that contrastive decoders improve scores on unsupported initial answers but reduce scores on supported answers in ordinary passages, identifying a source of the trade-off between the two passage types. • We propose Accept-or-Repair, a training-free procedure that keeps supported answers and tries up to two contrastive repairs for the others, subject to the memory veto. • We show that AoR retains its lead on held-out benchmarks and across model families and sizes, and improves scores on both passage types when answers are given as one sentence.
blocks.zh: - 我们作出三项贡献。 我们显示对比解码器在无支持的初始答案上提高分数,但在普通段落中减少支持的答案上的分数,确定两种通道类型之间的权衡来源. ^ 我们提议接受或再补偿,这是一种无训练程序,它保持得到支持的答案,并尝试对其他答案进行两次对比性修理,但需遵守记忆否决权。 我们显示,AoR在搁置基准上以及跨模范家庭和规模上保持领先地位,并在回答为一句话时提高两种通道类型的分数。

blocks.en: We show that contrastive decoders improve scores on unsupported initial answers but reduce scores on supported answers in ordinary passages, identifying a source of the trade-off between the two passage types.
blocks.zh: 我们显示对比解码器在不支持的初始答案上提高分数,但在普通段落中减少支持的答案上的分数,确定两种通道类型之间的权衡来源.

blocks.en: We propose Accept-or-Repair, a training-free procedure that keeps supported answers and tries up to two contrastive repairs for the others, subject to the memory veto.
blocks.zh: 我们提议接受或再补偿,这是一种无培训程序,它保持得到支持的答案,并试图对其他答案进行两次对比性修复,但需遵守记忆否决权。

blocks.en: We show that AoR retains its lead on held-out benchmarks and across model families and sizes, and improves scores on both passage types when answers are given as one sentence.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,AoR在搁置基准上以及跨模范家庭和规模上保持领先地位,并在回答为一句话时提高两种通道类型的分数。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Models can favor memorized knowledge over conflicting passages and be misled by irrelevant context ( Longpre et al., 2021 ; Xie et al., 2024 ; Shi et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2024 ; Lee et al., 2026e ) .
FaithEval and ConFiQA evaluate whether models base their answers on counterfactual passages ( Ming et al., 2025 ; Bi et al., 2025 ) .
Prompting improves faithfulness to the passage through opinion-based questions and counterfactual demonstrations ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh:
模型可以倾向于记住知识而不是相互矛盾的段落,并被无关的上下文所误导(Longpre等人,2021年;Xie等人,2017年). 2024; Shi等人, 2023; 徐等人, 2024; Lee等人, 2026e.).
FaithEval和ConFiQA评价模型是否基于反事实段落(Ming等人,2025年;Bi等人,2025年)。
迅速提高通过基于意见的问题和反事实示威的忠诚度(周等人,2023年).

blocks.en:
Contrastive decoding adjusts token scores by comparing predictions from the original input with those obtained without the passage, with an irrelevant passage, or with a modified instruction ( van der Poel et al., 2022 ; Shi et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2024a ) .
Methods control contrastive decoding using distribution divergence, entropy, confidence signals, or a tunable factor ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Yuan et al., 2024 ; Qiu et al., 2025 ; Khandelwal et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2024b ; Li et al., 2026 ; He et al., 2025 ) .
Gating and routing determine when to apply the contrast or which decoding regime to use ( Tao and Agrawal, 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2026c ; Kang et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2026d ) .
Other methods encourage models to follow the passage by adjusting token probabilities or steering hidden representations ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Gema et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Minder et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025b ) .
AoR combines answer selection with contrastive decoding to keep supported initial answers and repair unsupported ones.
blocks.zh:
对比解码通过比较原始输入的预测与未通过时获得的预测,不相关段落,或修改指令(van der Poel等人,2022年;Shi等人,2024年;Zhao等人,2024年;Kim等人,2024年a年)来调整符号分数.
使用分布差、py、置信信号或金枪鱼因子控制对比性解码的方法(Wang等人,2025a); 袁等编,. 2024;邱等人,2025;Khandelwal等人,2025;Kim等人,2024b;Li等人,2026;He等人,2025).
定格和路由决定何时应用对比或使用何种解码制度(Tao and Agrawal,2026;Jiang等人,2026;Zhou等人,2026;Lee等人,2026c;Kang等人,2026;Lee等人,2026d).
其他方法鼓励模型通过调整符号概率或引导隐藏的表示来跟踪通过(Zhang等人,2026;Gema等人,2025;Zhao等人,2025;Minder等人,2025;Wang等人,2025b)。
AoR将答案选择与对比解码相结合,以保留支持的初始答案并修复不支持的答案.

blocks.en:
Methods select among sampled answers by frequency or a trained verifier’s score ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Cobbe et al., 2021 ; Lee et al., 2026b ; Lee et al., 2026f ) , and model cascades use learned estimates of answer quality to decide whether to query another model ( Chen et al., 2024 ) .
Verification methods use self-critique, retrieved evidence, or attention signals to select or revise generated text ( Asai et al., 2024 ; Gao et al., 2023 ; Dhuliawala et al., 2024 ; Chuang et al., 2024 ; Lee et al., 2026a ; Lee and Park, 2026 ) .
AoR selects initial answers for repair using a lexical test against the passage, without a trained verifier, self-verification prompts, or access to attention weights.
blocks.zh:
根据频率或经过培训的核查者得分在抽样答复中选择方法(Wang等人,2023年;Cobbe等人,2021年;Lee等人,2026年b年;Lee等人,2026年f年),模型级联使用所学得的答案质量估计来决定是否查询另一个模型(Chen等人,2024年).
核查方法使用自我判断,检索的证据,或注意信号来选择或修改生成的文本(Asai等人,2024年;Gao等人,2023年;Dhuliawala等人,2024年;Chuang等人,2024年;Lee等人,2026年a;Lee and Park,2026年).
AoR使用针对通道的词典测试来选择修复的初始答案,没有经过训练的验证器,自我验证的提示,或者获取注意力重量.

blocks.en: 3 Accept-or-Repair
blocks.zh: 3 接受或恢复

blocks.en:
A model generates a short answer from a prompt containing a passage c c and a question q q .
We write a ∼ D a\sim D for an answer generated from this prompt using decoder D D .
AoR keeps the initial answer from plain sampling if the passage supports it.
Otherwise, it generates replacements with contrastive decoders and checks them against the passage, as shown in Algorithm 1 .
blocks.zh:
一个模型从一个包含 c 段和 question q q 的提示中生成一个简短的答案.
我们用解码器 D 来写一个“ Da\sim D ” , 用于解码器 。
AoR将初始答案保存在简单的采样中,如果通过支持的话.
否则,它用对比解码器产生替换,并对照通道检查,如Algorithm 1 所示.

blocks.en:
For short free-form answers, the support test Supp ⁡ ( a , c ) \operatorname{Supp}(a;c) accepts a a when its normalized form is nonempty and occurs in the normalized passage as a contiguous sequence of whole tokens.
Normalization lowercases the text, replaces ASCII punctuation with spaces, preserves non-ASCII punctuation and symbols as separate tokens, and removes articles.
For free-form questions, an answer that normalizes to yes or no passes the support test even if it does not occur in the passage.
For multiple-choice questions, the answer is an option letter. It passes the support test when the selected option’s text occurs in the passage and no other option’s text does.
For sentence answers, we exclude words that occur in the question and function words such as articles and prepositions. The answer passes the test when at least one word remains and all remaining words occur in the passage.
blocks.zh:
对于简短的自由式答案,支持测试 Supp QQ( a, c)\operatorname{ Supp}(a;c) 接受其正态为非空态且在正态通道中发生为整体符号的毗连序列时.
规范化小写文本,用空格取代ASCII punctuation,保留非ASCII punctuation和符号作为单独的符号,并删除文章.
对于自由形式问题,一个常态化为是或否的答案会通过支持测试,即使没有在通道中出现.
对于多选题,答案是一个选项字母. 当选定选项的文本出现在段落中,而其他选项的文本则没有,则通过支持测试。
对于句子答案,我们排除了问题中发生的词,并功能词如文章和前置. 当至少有一个单词留下,所有剩余单词在段落中出现时,答案通过测试.

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 Accept-or-Repair
blocks.zh: 算法 1 接受或重置

blocks.en: AoR first draws a plain answer a a and returns it unchanged when Supp ⁡ ( a , c ) \operatorname{Supp}(a;c) holds, without applying contrastive decoding.
blocks.zh: AoR 首先绘制一个简单的答案 a, 当 Supp \ \\ (a,c)\ operatorname{ Supp}(a;c) 持有时返回, 而不应用对比解码 。

blocks.en:
If the initial answer fails the support test, AoR draws candidate answers from D 1 , … , D K D_{1},\dots,D_{K} in order.
It returns the first candidate that passes the test and is not rejected by the memory veto.
If no candidate passes both checks, AoR returns the first that states an answer and is not rejected by the veto, or the initial answer if no such candidate exists.
A candidate states an answer when its normalized text is nonempty for a free-form question or it gives a valid option letter for a multiple-choice question.
We use K = 2 K=2 , with CAD ( Shi et al., 2024 ) followed by Instructive Decoding (ID) ( Kim et al., 2024a ) , and select the decoders and their order on the development split.
For ID, the contrasting prompt instructs the model to ignore the passage.
We write AoR( D D ) for the variant that uses D D as its only repair without the memory veto.
blocks.zh:
如果初始答案失败支持测试, AoR 从 D 1, ..., D K D_{1},\dots, D_{K} 中抽取候选答案。
它返回第一个通过测试的候选人,不被内存否决否决.
如果没有候选人通过两次检查,Aor R返回第一个回答,没有被否决,或者如果不存在这种候选人,则返回最初回答。
候选者当其正则文本对自由形式问题不空或为多选择问题提供有效选项字母时,会表示答案.
我们使用K = 2 K = 2,CAD(Shi等人,2024年)之后是诱导解码(ID)(Kim等人,2024a),并选择解码器及其在开发拆分上的顺序.
对于ID,相对应的即时指示模型忽略通过.
我们为使用DD作为唯一修理的变体而写AoR(DD),没有内存否决权.

blocks.en:
For an unsupported initial answer, AoR draws a closed-book answer m m using plain sampling without the passage to screen repairs.
For free-form questions, if m m fails the support test, the veto rejects repairs that match m m after normalization.
Such repairs already fail the support test, so the veto prevents them from being returned as fallbacks.
For multiple-choice questions, an option scores 2 if its text occurs in the passage.
Otherwise, we exclude function words and use the fraction of the option’s remaining words that occur in the passage.
If another option scores higher than the option selected by m m , the veto masks the letter of m m during repair decoding.
For example, if m m is A and only option C’s text occurs in the passage, the veto masks A and leaves B, C and D unmasked.
An option whose text occurs in the passage receives the maximum score, so the veto does not mask it.
On a paraphrased passage, the veto leaves m m unmasked when no other option scores higher.
blocks.zh:
对于一个不支持的初始答案,AoR绘制了一个闭页答案m m,使用不通过屏幕修补的纯采样.
对于自由形式问题,如果m m 失败支持测试,否决权拒绝在正常化后进行匹配m m的修复.
此类维修已经没有通过支持测试,因此否决权阻止了它们作为倒置归还.
对于多个选择问题,如果文本发生在段落中,则选项得分2。
否则,我们排除功能词,使用该选项剩余词段的一小部分。
如果另一个选项得分高于 m 的选项, 则在修复解码时, 否决权会掩盖 m 的字母 。
例如,如果m m是A,而只有备选案文C的文本出现在段落中,则否决权会遮盖A,留下B、C和D。
在段落中出现文本的选项获得最高分,因此否决权不会掩盖它.
在一段被解释的段落中,当没有其他选项得分更高时,否决权就使m m 蒙羞。

blocks.en:
We analyze how retaining supported answers changes a decoder’s score.
Let S S be the event that the initial plain answer a a passes the support test, and let Q ⁡ ( a ) Q(a) and Q ⁡ ( D ) Q(D) denote the scores in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] of a a and a draw from decoder D D .
The expected score difference between D D and plain sampling is 𝔼 ⁡ [ Q ⁡ ( D ) − Q ⁡ ( a ) ] = P ⁡ ( S ) ​ Δ S + P ⁡ ( ¬ S ) ​ Δ ¬ S , \mathbb{E}[Q(D)-Q(a)]=P(S)\,\Delta_{S}+P(\neg S)\,\Delta_{\neg S}, (1) where Δ S = 𝔼 ⁡ [ Q ⁡ ( D ) − Q ⁡ ( a ) ∣ S ] \Delta_{S}=\mathbb{E}[Q(D)-Q(a)\mid S] and Δ ¬ S \Delta_{\neg S} is the same difference on unsupported initial answers.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en:
We evaluate whether AoR follows counterfactual passages while preserving accuracy on ordinary passages.
In the main comparison, NQ-Swap ( Longpre et al., 2021 ) replaces the answer entity in a Natural Questions passage ( Kwiatkowski et al., 2019 ) with another entity of the same type, and FaithEval’s counterfactual task ( Ming et al., 2025 ) asks multiple-choice questions whose passage supports a counterfactual answer.
The ordinary tasks are NQ-Original, which uses the original passages and answers from NQ-Swap, SQuAD ( Rajpurkar et al., 2016 ) and HotpotQA ( Yang et al., 2018 ) in the distractor setting.
For HotpotQA, we concatenate two supporting paragraphs with up to eight distractors.
We also evaluate on the counterfactual subsets of ConFiQA ( Bi et al., 2025 ) .
For ordinary passages, we use ConFiQA’s original passages and answers, TriviaQA ( Joshi et al., 2017 ; Fisch et al., 2019 ) and SciQ ( Welbl et al., 2017 ) .
blocks.zh:
我们评价AOR是否遵循反事实通道,同时保持普通通道的准确性.
在主比较中,NQ-Swap(Longpre等人,2021年)在自然问题通道(Kwiatkowski等人,2019年)中将答案实体替换为另一类实体,FaithEval的反事实任务(Ming等人,2025年)提出了多个选择问题,其通过支持反事实答案.
普通任务为NQ-原始,使用NQ-Swap,SQuAD(Rajpurkar et al.,2016年)和HotpotQA(Yang et al.,2018年)在分散器设置中的原始段落和答案.
对于HotpotQA,我们召集两个支持段落,最多8个分心器.
我们还评估了ConFiQA(Bi等人,2025年)的反事实子集。
对于普通段落,我们使用ConFiQA的原始段落和答案,TriviaQA(Joshi等人,2017年;Fisch等人,2019年)和SciQ(Welbl等人,2017年).

blocks.en:
The main comparison uses Qwen3 models with 1.7B, 4B, 8B and 14B parameters ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) , Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct ( Llama Team, 2024 ) and Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 ( Jiang et al., 2023 ; Mistral AI, 2024 ) .
We also evaluate Qwen3-32B, Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct, OLMo-2-13B-Instruct ( Team OLMo et al., 2024 ) and Yi-1.5-9B-Chat ( Young et al., 2024 ; 01.AI, 2024 ) to examine performance across model sizes and families.
All models are instruction-tuned, and Qwen3 runs in non-thinking mode.
For each model, the methods share the temperature and top- p p sampling settings ( Holtzman et al., 2020 ) listed in Table 10 , with top- k k filtering enabled for Qwen3.
Temperature scaling and filtering follow any contrastive adjustment of token scores.
We share sampling noise across methods within each run and average the scores over three seeds.
blocks.zh:
主要比较使用Quen3模型,参数为1.7B,4B,8B和14B(Quen Team,2025年),Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct(Llama Team,2024年)和Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3(Jiang等人,2023年;Mistral AI,2024年).
我们还评价了Qune3-32B,Llama-31-70B-Instruct,OLMo-2-13B-Instruct(Team OLMo等人,2024年)和Yi-1.5-9B-Chat(Young等人,2024年;01.AI,2024年),以检查跨模型大小和家庭的性能.
所有型号都经过了指令调试,而Quen3则以非思考模式运行.
对于每个模型,方法共享表10所列的温度和顶端-p采样设置(Holtzman等人,2020年),对Quen3启用顶端-k 过滤.
温度缩放和过滤遵循任何对符号分数的对比性调整.
我们在每个赛跑中分享不同方法的取样噪音,平均得分超过三个种子。

blocks.en:
CAD, AdaCAD, COIECD and No-Worse CAD (NWCAD) use the question alone as the contrastive input ( Shi et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Yuan et al., 2024 ; Tao and Agrawal, 2026 ) .
Random-passage CD (RPCD) contrasts with another example’s passage ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) , and ID with an instruction to ignore the passage ( Kim et al., 2024a ) .
To compare their contrastive inputs, we use the CAD scoring rule for both baselines.
Strict prompt asks the model to answer only from the passage ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) , and Strict CAD applies CAD to that prompt.
Contrastive settings are selected on the development split and kept fixed across models and tasks.
We choose the setting with the highest average gain over sampling across the two task groups, retaining a recommended setting when it is within 0.1 points of the best.
Strict CAD uses CAD’s selected strength, and AoR uses the selected CAD and ID strengths for its repairs.
blocks.zh:
CAD, AdaCAD, COIECD和No-Worse CAD (NWCAD)单独使用这个问题作为对比性输入(Shi等人,2024年;Wang等人,2025年a;袁等人,2024年;Tao和Agrawal,2026年).
随机通过CD(RPCD)与另一个例子的通过(Zhao等人,2024年)和ID有忽略通过的指示(Kim等人,2024a年)形成对比.
为了比较它们的对比性输入,我们用CAD的评分规则来计算这两个基线.
严格提示要求模式只从通过(周等人,2023年)中回复,严格提示CAD将CAD应用于该提示.
在开发拆分上选择矛盾的设置,并固定在模型和任务之间.
我们选择平均收益最高的设定,而不是两个工作组的取样,在不超过0.1最佳点时保留建议设定。
严格的CAD使用CAD的选定强度,AoR使用选定的CAD和ID强度进行修复.

blocks.en:
We use token-level F1 for free-form answers and accuracy for multiple-choice answers.
For the main comparison, we average task scores within the counterfactual and ordinary groups and report Mean as the average of the two group scores.
We assess score differences with 95% confidence intervals from paired bootstrap resampling ( Berg-Kirkpatrick et al., 2012 ) .
Cost is the number of tokens processed across decoding calls, including prompts, relative to plain sampling.
Appendices A through D give the prompts, settings and scoring procedures.
blocks.zh:
我们使用符号级的F1来进行自由式的答案和对多个选择的答案的精确度.
就主要比较而言,我们在反事实组和普通组内的平均任务分数,报告平均分数为两个组的平均分数。
我们评估了95%的置信间隔与对靴子重新取样(Berg-Kirkpatrick等人,2012年)。
成本是指相对于普通采样而言,通过解码呼叫处理的符号数量,包括提示.
附录A至D给出了提示,设置和评分程序.

blocks.zh: 图3:(a) AoR如何在六个模型上完成每项任务:接受简单答案,支持修复,或者不支持绘图。 (b) 在五种尺寸的Quen3型号上的平均值。

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en:
We find that AoR is the only method to improve significantly over sampling in both task groups, by 12.5 points on counterfactual passages and 2.3 on ordinary passages, as Table 1 shows.
It scores highest on each task and significantly outperforms the baselines in Mean.
Strict CAD, CAD and COIECD make the largest counterfactual gains among the baselines but lose on ordinary passages, whereas the other baselines leave ordinary scores nearly unchanged and gain less on counterfactual passages.
The lead in Mean holds on each model, as reported in Appendix H .
AoR has a token cost of 1.71 times that of sampling, lower than RPCD and ID.
blocks.zh:
我们发现,正如表1所示,两个任务组中,AoR是比采样大为改进的唯一方法,反事实段落为12.5点,普通段落为2.3点。
它在每个任务上得分最高,并且大大超过了平均值的基线。
严格的CAD、CAD和COIECD在基线中取得了最大的反事实收益,但在普通通道上却有所损失,而其他基线则使普通的分数几乎保持不变,在反事实通道上收益较少。
如附录H所报告,“平均”中的铅在每种模式上都存在。
AoR的象征性成本是抽样的1.71倍,低于RPCD和ID.

blocks.en: Figure 4: F1 change on the supported plain answers of the ordinary tasks, binned by the probability that the model gives the same answer without the passage.
blocks.zh: 图4:F1在普通任务所支持的平面答案上的变化,被模型在没有段落的情况下给出相同答案的概率所吞噬.

blocks.en:
We find that the baselines improve on unsupported initial answers in both groups but lose on supported answers in ordinary passages, as Table 2 shows.
Figure 4 shows larger F1 losses for Strict CAD, CAD and COIECD in bins where the model assigns higher probability to the initial answer without the passage.
By retaining supported answers, AoR avoids this loss term in Equation 1 .
It turns 4 of the 24,639 correct initial answers on ordinary passages into errors and corrects more wrong initial answers on counterfactual passages than the baselines.
These findings suggest that retaining supported answers helps turn contrastive repairs into gains on ordinary passages.
blocks.zh:
我们发现,如表2所示,基线在两个组中都改进了未经支持的初步答案,但在普通段落中失去了支持的答案。
图4显示在垃圾箱中,模型为没有通道的初始答案分配了更高的概率的严格CAD,CAD和COIECD的较大的F1损失.
通过保留支持的答案,AoR在方程式1中避免了这一损失术语.
它使24,639个普通段落上正确的初始答案中的4个变成错误,并更正了反事实段落上比基线更错误的初始答案.
这些调查结果表明,保留支持的答案有助于将对比性修复转化为普通通道上的收益。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Counterfactual and ordinary averages of CAD, ID and RPCD at four strengths, alone and wrapped by AoR as the only repair. Dotted lines mark sampling.
blocks.zh: 图5:CAD,ID和RPCD四强的反事实和普通平均值,单独由AoR包扎作为唯一的修复. 点线标记采样。

blocks.en:
We find that replacing only unsupported initial answers significantly improves the Mean of each baseline, as Table 3 shows.
Each baseline serves as AoR’s only repair in this comparison, without the memory veto.
On ordinary passages, the gains recover the losses on supported answers in Table 2 , as Equation 2 predicts.
Counterfactual scores remain nearly unchanged.
blocks.zh:
我们发现,如表3所示,仅取代未经支持的初步答案可大大改善每个基准的平均值。
每一基线都是AorR在比较中的唯一修复,没有记忆否决权.
在普通段落中,收益根据表2中支持的答案收回损失,如第2项预测。
反事实分数几乎没有变化。

blocks.en:
We also compare four contrast strengths for CAD, ID and RPCD to test whether this benefit depends on the selected setting.
Without AoR, all three decoders score below sampling on ordinary passages at the strongest setting, as Figure 5 shows.
With AoR, counterfactual scores rise with contrast strength while ordinary scores stay above sampling, giving each decoder its highest Mean at the strongest setting.
These findings suggest that retaining supported answers allows stronger contrastive repairs while preserving performance on ordinary passages.
blocks.zh:
我们还比较了CAD、ID和RPCD的四种对比优势,以检验这种好处是否取决于选定的环境。
如图5所示,没有AOR,所有三个解码器在最强的设定下在普通段落上得分低于采样.
与AoR相比,反事实分数随对比强度而上升,而普通分数则停留在采样之上,使每个解码器在最强的设定下达到最高平均值.
这些调查结果表明,保留所支持的答案可以加强对比性修理,同时保留普通通道上的性能。

blocks.zh: 表4:AoR的备选案文和多数票。 分数差异是相对于AoR的;颜色表示95%的间隔不包括0. 成本是相对于采样的符号计数.

blocks.en: Table 5: Gain over sampling when CAD replaces selected answers on free-form tasks. Four ranked gates match the support test’s selection count. Mean averages NQ-Swap and Ord. Color indicates 95% intervals excluding zero.
blocks.zh: 表5: CAD 替换 free-form 任务的选定答案时比采样增益. 4个排名的闸门符合支持测试的选择计数 。 NQ- Swap 和 Ord 的平均值。 颜色表示95%的间隔, 不包括0 。

blocks.en:
Keeping supported initial answers improves ordinary scores and reduces token cost, as Table 4 shows.
Allowing partial matches between answers and passage spans lowers the Mean and admits more memorized answers on NQ-Swap.
Removing the memory veto lowers FaithEval accuracy, and removing either repair lowers scores on both passage types.
blocks.zh:
如表4所示,保留支持的初始答案可以提高普通分数,降低象征性成本。
允许部分匹配的答案和跨度降低平均值,并在NQ-Swap上承认更多被记住的答案.
删除内存否决权会降低FaithEval的准确性,并删除任何一种修补都会降低两种通道类型的分数.

blocks.en:
Replacing contrastive repairs with samples from the strict or plain prompt lowers AoR’s Mean by 3.0 to 3.9 points, with larger losses on counterfactual passages.
The strict-prompt variant still outperforms the baselines in Mean.
Majority voting ( Wang et al., 2023 ) yields lower scores than AoR on both passage types and uses more tokens.
These comparisons suggest that AoR benefits from both checking answers against the passage and using contrastive decoding to generate repairs.
blocks.zh:
以严格或平坦的“AOR平均值”的样本取代对比性修复,比“AOR平均值”低3.0至3.9点,反事实通道损失更大。
严格即时变体仍然超过平均值的基线。
多数投票(Wang等人,2023年)在通过类型上得分均低于AoR,并使用较多的代币.
这些比较表明,AoR既可以检查通过时的答案,也可以使用对比解码来产生修理。

blocks.en:
Adding Strict CAD restricted to passage spans as a third repair raises the Mean at a higher token cost.
The lead of AoR over the baselines in Mean also holds across the 16 combinations of CAD and ID strengths, as Appendix E shows.
blocks.zh:
加上严格的CAD,限制在通过期间,因为第三次修理以更高的象征性成本提高了平均值。
如附录E所示,AoR在平均基线上的领先地位也存在于CAD和ID的16种优势组合中。

blocks.en:
The support test gives the largest gains on NQ-Swap and ordinary passages among the selection criteria in Table 5 .
We compare it with answer probability, the probability gain from adding the passage, a model self-check ( Kadavath et al., 2022 ) and an entailment score.
To isolate the selection criterion, each alternative replaces the same number of initial answers as the support test, using the same CAD outputs without further checks.
blocks.zh:
支持测试在NQ-Swap和表5选择标准中的普通段落中获得了最大的收益。
我们把它与答案概率、增加通道的概率收益、模型自查(Kadavath等人,2022年)和必然得分进行比较。
为了隔离选择标准,每个选项都会替换与支持测试相同的初始答案数量,使用相同的CAD输出,无需进一步检查.

blocks.en:
On NQ-Swap, the support test selects 99.5% of initial answers that repeat the answer from the original passage, compared with 54–55% for answer probability, self-check and entailment.
This difference suggests that passage support helps identify memorized answers that these three criteria miss.
blocks.zh:
在NQ-Swap上,支持测试选择了99.5%的初始答案从原始段落中重复答案,而54–55%的答案概率,自我检查和内含.
这一差异表明,通过支持有助于确定这三项标准所忽略的被记住的答案。

blocks.en: 6 Analysis
blocks.zh: 6 分析

blocks.en: Table 6: Beyond the main setting: Mean, or group average for held-out data. No FaithEval: NQ-Swap, ordinary average; With veto: veto for all; Greedy: four models, retuned, first row greedy; Distractors: passages of four other questions; Judge: free-form Mean gain over sampling.

blocks.en: Table 7: Test answers from three models, with passage excerpts, illustrating acceptance, CAD and ID repairs, and the memory veto. A check marks a correct answer; labels below AoR’s answers indicate the action taken.
blocks.zh: 表7:三种模式的测试答案,有段落节选,说明接受,CAD和ID修复,以及内存否决权. 检查标记了正确的答案; AOR 的答案下面的标签表明了所采取的行动。

blocks.en:
AoR outperforms the baselines in average score across the comparisons in Table 6 .
The lead remains when we exclude FaithEval and when the baselines receive the same memory veto, indicating that neither the multiple-choice task nor the veto alone accounts for the advantage.
Across model families, we find that AoR improves on sampling on OLMo-2-13B and Yi-1.5-9B, where most contrastive baselines score below sampling.
Its lead over the best baseline grows from about 3 points for Qwen3 models up to 8B to 5.7 points at 32B, as Figure 3 b shows.
This suggests that checking which answers need repair remains useful as model size increases.
blocks.zh:
通过表6的比较,AoR在平均得分上超过了基线。
当我们排除FaithEval和当基线获得同样的记忆否决权时,领先地位依然存在,这表明,无论是多重选择任务,还是否决权本身,都不是优势所在。
整个模范家庭,我们发现AOR改进了OLMo-2-13B和Yi-1.5-9B的采样,其中对比度最高的基线得分低于采样.
如图3b所示,它在最佳基准上的领先点从Qune3型号的约3点增加到8B到32B的5.7点。
这表明,随着模型尺寸的增加,检查哪些答案需要修复仍然有用。

blocks.en:
With the decoder settings retuned for greedy decoding, AoR retains its lead over the baselines.
It also improves over sampling when answers are given as one sentence, as detailed in Appendix F .
Under two LLM judges that accept paraphrased answers, AoR ranks highest on average, suggesting that its gains are not explained by word-overlap scoring alone.
blocks.zh:
随着解码器设置重新调整为贪婪的解码,AoR保留了在基线上的领先地位.
如附录F所详述的,如果将答案作为一句话给出,它也比抽样有所改进。
在接受解释性答案的两名LLM法官之下,Aor R平均排名最高,表明其收益并非仅用字数重叠评分来解释。

blocks.en:
AoR accepts 82 to 86% of initial answers on ordinary passages and 70% on NQ-Swap, as Figure 3 a shows.
It returns them unchanged, without repair decoding or a closed-book draw.
Across free-form tasks, AoR finds a supported repair for more than half of the rejected initial answers.
On most FaithEval questions, the passage contains no option text or multiple option texts, so no answer passes the support test and AoR returns a fallback answer.
In these cases, the memory veto can still mask the closed-book option during repair decoding when the passage favors another.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
We propose Accept-or-Repair, a training-free procedure that keeps passage-supported initial answers and uses contrastive decoding to repair unsupported ones.
AoR also applies the memory veto to reject repairs that repeat the answer generated without the passage when the passage favors another answer.
AoR improves average scores over plain sampling on counterfactual and ordinary passages across ten models.
In the main evaluation on six models and five benchmarks, it yields large gains on counterfactual passages and small gains on ordinary ones.
Replacing only unsupported initial answers improves the average score of every decoder in this evaluation, compared with using that decoder to answer every question.
Our findings suggest that checking passage support helps models follow passages that contradict their knowledge while preserving accuracy on passages that agree with it.

我们提议接受或恢复,这是一种无培训程序,它保持通过支持的初步答案,并使用对比解码来修复没有支持的答案。

AoR在反事实和跨越十个模型的普通通道上比普通采样提高了平均分数.
在对6种模式和5种基准的主要评价中,它在反事实通道方面取得巨大收益,在普通通道上获得小收益。
仅取代无支持的初始解码器可以提高本评价中每个解码器的平均分数,而使用该解码器来回答每个问题.
我们的调查结果表明,检查通过支持有助于模型遵循与它们的知识相矛盾的段落,同时保持同意这些段落的准确性。

For short free-form answers, the support test reads the first line.

An answer is correct when it matches a gold answer exactly, or for FaithEval when it names the right option.
On ordinary passages, 83.6% of the plain answers are supported and score 82.5 F1.
On these answers CAD scores 4.1 points lower and Strict CAD 6.2.
CAD changes 18.5% of them, and 41% of these changes give an answer that the passage does not contain.
The 4 correct plain answers that AoR breaks on ordinary passages are unsupported because the passage contains the gold answer only inside a longer word, as Ghana inside Ghanaian .
blocks.zh:
在表2中,支持由AoR测试确定.
当一个答案完全匹配一个黄金答案时,或者当FaithEval指定正确的选项时,答案是正确的.
在普通通道上,83.6%的平面答案得到支持,得分为82.5 F1.
在这些答案上,CAD的分数是4.1分低,严格CAD 6.2.
CAD修改了其中的18.5%,其中41%的修改给出了一个段落没有包含的答案.
AOR在普通通道上断裂的4个正确的平坦答案是不被支持的, 因为通道只包含一个较长的词,

blocks.en:
Of the plain answers that the test accepts on ordinary passages, 84.9% have an F1 of at least 0.5.
Using this threshold to define correctness, every baseline breaks more supported initial answers than it corrects, from 1.6 times as many for NWCAD to 4.9 times for Strict CAD.
Within this supported subset, retaining the initial answers improves the binary score over the decoder exactly when this ratio exceeds one.
Across free-form tasks, 72 to 95% of supported plain, CAD and ID draws have an F1 of at least 0.5, compared with 16 to 53% of unsupported draws.
1.7% of the plain answers that AoR accepts on NQ-Swap equal the closed-book answer.
On the 6.6 to 20.5% of ordinary examples whose passage also contains a wrong closed-book answer, AoR scores highest on each ordinary task.
blocks.zh:
在测试在普通通道上接受的简单答案中,84.9%的F1至少是0.5.
使用这一阈值来定义正确性,每个基线打破的支持初始答案比正确多,从NWCAD的1.6倍到严格CAD的4.9倍.
在此所支持的子集中,保留初始的答案可以使二进制分数在解码器上精确地在这个比例超过一个时得到改进.
在自由形式任务中,72%至95%的支持平原、CAD和ID绘图的F1至少为0.5,而16%至53%的支持不支持的绘图。
AOR在NQ-Swap上接受的1.7%的简单答案等于闭页答案.
在6.6%到20.5%的普通例子上,如果这些例子的通过也包含一个错误的封闭本答案,AoR在每个普通任务上得分最高.

blocks.en:
Table 13 gives the share and the plain F1 of each bin of Figure 4 , with the probability taken under the closed-book prompt.
Strict CAD, CAD and COIECD lose more F1 in the higher closed-book probability bins, while AdaCAD, which weakens the contrast where the two predictions agree, loses little across bins.
CAD, COIECD and Strict CAD break correct supported answers more often when the closed-book answer is also correct.
With correctness defined as in Table 2 and the six models pooled, CAD breaks 15.1% of these answers, compared with 11.5% when the closed-book answer is wrong.
The corresponding rates are 14.7 and 11.3% for COIECD, and 18.8 and 15.1% for Strict CAD.
RPCD and ID, whose contrasting prompt also contains a passage, show the opposite pattern, with rates of 9.0 versus 9.9% for RPCD and 7.1 versus 9.1% for ID.
On ordinary passages, a second plain sample breaks 2.7% of correct initial answers, compared with 12.2% for CAD using the same noise as the initial sample.
blocks.zh:
表13给出了图4中每个本的比重和平面F1,并给出了在闭页提示下得出的概率.
严格CAD,CAD和COIECD在较高的闭帐概率箱中损失更多F1,而AdaCAD则削弱了两种预测一致的对比度,在bins间损失很少.
CAD,COIECD和严格CAD的断句在闭页解答也正确时更经常支持的答案.
CAD以表2和六个模型集合中定义的正确性,打破了15.1%的这些答案,而闭页答案错误时则打破了11.5%。
COIECD的相应比率为14.7%和11.3%,严格CAD的相应比率为18.8%和15.1%。
RPCD和ID的对比率也包含一个通道,呈现出相反的模式,RPCD的比分是9.0%,而ID的比分是7.1%。
在普通通道上,第二个平原样本打破2.7%的正确初始答案,而CAD则使用与初始样本相同的噪音.

blocks.en:
Every gain in Mean of Table 3 , from 0.1 to 2.7 points, is significant.
Draws that state no answer are rare, so ϵ \epsilon in Equation 2 stays below 0.3 points.
The counterfactual score of each wrapped decoder stays within 0.7 points of its score when used alone.
blocks.zh:
表3的平均值从0.1点到2.7点的每个增益都很大。
绘制状态无答案是罕见的,所以在方程式2中\\epsilon保持在0.3分以下.
每个包裹的解码器的反事实分数在单独使用时会停留在其分数的0.7点以内.

blocks.en:
Table 14 gives six variants of Table 4 on each task, together with a fallback to the plain answer.
Without the initial acceptance test, AoR still scores 75.7 on ordinary passages, above sampling.
The support checks on repairs remain in place.
Accepting an answer that some span of the passage matches with a token F1 of at least 0.5 or 0.8 gives a Mean of 73.1 or 74.4.
On 4.4% of NQ-Swap questions, the 0.5 threshold accepts an initial answer containing the answer from the original passage.
CAD or ID alone lowers the Mean by 1.3 points, and at the 16 combinations of CAD and ID strengths the Mean lies between 72.5 and 75.4.
blocks.zh:
表14列出了表4关于每项任务的6个变体,以及一个倒置的简单答案。
没有初始接受测试,AoR仍然在普通通道上评分75.7,高于采样.
维修支助检查仍然有效。
接受一个回答,即某段通道与至少0.5或0.8的标志F1相匹配,平均值为73.1或74.4。
在4.4%的NQ-Swap问题上,0.5阈值接受包含原段答案的初始答案.
单是CAD或ID就将平均值降低1.3点,在CAD和ID的16种组合中,平均值的优势在72.5和75.4之间。

blocks.en:
Removing the memory veto lowers FaithEval accuracy by 6.4 points and the counterfactual average by 3.2 points.
Table 15 separates the veto from the decoders on FaithEval, and Table 16 gives the veto to every baseline.
The first row of Table 15 picks the option with the highest veto score and splits ties evenly.
A decoder with the veto returns the answer of its run with the masked letter where the veto holds and its usual answer elsewhere.
On free-form tasks, the veto does not alter a baseline’s answer because it filters only the fallback candidates used by AoR.
The baselines with the veto trail AoR by at least 1.2 points on counterfactual and 2.2 on ordinary passages.
blocks.zh:
取消内存否决权后,FaithEval的精度降低6.4分,反事实平均值降低3.2分.
表15将否决权与FaithEval上的解码器区分开来,表16为每个基线提供了否决权。
表15的第一行选择了否决权得分最高的选项,并平分了关系.
一个拥有否决权的解码员用否决权所在的蒙面字母和其他地方的通常答案来回答其竞选的答案。
在自由形式的任务上,否决权不会改变基线的答案,因为否决权只过滤AOR使用的后退候选人。
拥有否决权的基线在反事实方面比Aor R至少高出1.2分,在普通段落方面高出2.2分。

blocks.en:
With repairs sampled from the strict prompt, AoR achieves a Mean of 71.9, 1.4 points above Strict CAD.
On NQ-Swap, the gain over sampling is 4.2 points, compared with 8.3 with contrastive repairs.
blocks.zh:
由于从严格的速率中抽取了修理样本,AoR达到比严格CAD高71.9,1.4分的平均值.
在NQ-Swap上,比采样得到的增益为4.2分,而对比性维修得到的增益为8.3分.

blocks.en:
The voting variants in Table 4 select the most frequent answer after applying the support test’s normalization.
One votes among the plain answers of three runs, and the other among the plain, CAD and ID answers of one run.
Both return the initial plain answer when no answer occurs twice.
blocks.zh:
表4中的表决变体在应用支持测试的正常化后选择最常见的答案.
在3次运行的简单答案中,有1票,在1次运行的平原、CAD和ID答案中,有1票。
当两次没有回答时,两者都返回初始的简单答案.

blocks.en:
The feedback repair adds the unsupported plain answer as an assistant turn and the feedback instruction from Table 8 as a new user turn, then samples another answer with the same noise.
Asked again, the model repeats 45% of the rejected answers, after the normalization of the support test, and 15% of its new answers are supported, against 33% of the CAD answers to the same questions.
As the only repair of AoR, feedback gains 1.6 points over sampling on NQ-Swap and 0.2 on ordinary passages.
A CAD repair gives larger gains of 5.9 and 1.3 points, respectively, at a similar token cost.
blocks.zh:
反馈修补增加了不支持的普通答案作为助手转弯,表8的反馈指令作为新的用户转弯,然后以相同的噪音对另一个答案进行样本.
再次被问到,模型重复了45%的被拒绝的答案,在支持测试正常化后,其15%的新答案得到支持,而CAD中33%的答案是相同的问题.
作为AoR的唯一修复,反馈比NQ-Swap上的采样和普通通道上的0.2得到1.6分.
一次CAD修复分别以类似的象征性成本获得5.9分和1.3分的较大收益.

blocks.en:
Table 17 compares other ways to answer in the words of the passage, and AoR with one repair, on the four free-form tasks, since a multiple-choice answer is a letter.
Span decoding samples the plain answer under the constraint that it is a span of the passage.
At each step, it considers the 64 highest-probability tokens and keeps those that extend a prefix of a passage span starting at a word boundary, or a prefix of yes or no.
The answer can end only at a complete passage span or at yes or no.
If no token satisfies the constraint before the answer is complete, decoding continues without the constraint.
The copy prompt of Table 8 asks for the answer copied from the passage, for sampling and for CAD, which keeps its closed-book prompt.
The copy prompt lowers the ordinary score by 1.3 points, and span decoding trails AoR by 3.8 points on NQ-Swap and 0.7 on ordinary passages.
blocks.zh:
表17比较了通过词中的其他回答方式,AoR用一个修补,对四个自由形式的任务,因为一个多选择的回答是一个字母.
Span 解码样本 普通答案在制约下, 它是一个跨度 通过。
在每个步骤上,它都考虑64个最高概率的符号,并保留那些从字形边界开始延伸一个通道跨度的前缀,或者一个是或否的前缀.
答案只能以完整通过或是或否结束。
如果在答复完成之前没有令状满足了约束,则解码继续没有约束.
表8的复制提示要求从段落中复制答案、取样和CAD,CAD保持了闭页快捷。
复制提示将普通分数降低1.3分,并在NQ-Swap和普通分数上横跨解码小径3.8分和0.7分.

blocks.en:
Span Strict CAD in Table 4 is Strict CAD decoded under the constraint of span decoding.
Among six repair sequences with a span-restricted draw that we compared on the development split, the sequence that ends with it scores highest on NQ-Swap and on the ordinary tasks.
On the test split it raises NQ-Swap from 65.2 to 67.6 and the Mean of each of the six models.
Without the constraint, Strict CAD as the third repair raises the Mean by 0.4 points.
blocks.zh:
表4中的Span严格CAD是在跨度解码的限制下解码的严格CAD.
在6个修补序列中,我们比较了开发拆分的跨度限制图,其结束的序列在NQ-Swap和普通任务上得分最高.
在试验分拆时,将NQ-Swap从65.2提高到67.6,并将6种型号中的每个型号的平均值提高。
在没有限制的情况下,严格CAD作为第三修补法将平均分提高了0.4分.

blocks.en:
Table 5 compares gates for selecting which initial answers to replace on the four free-form tasks.
All gates use the CAD answer from the same run as the only repair and return it without a support check.
For each model, task and run, four gates rank initial answers and flag the same number as the support test rejects.
The first two rank by mean token log-probability and by the gain in log-probability from adding the passage to the prompt.
The third uses the probability of yes when the answering model is asked whether the passage supports its answer ( Kadavath et al., 2022 ) .
The fourth uses entailment probability from DeBERTa-v3-large ( He et al., 2023 ) fine-tuned for natural language inference by Laurer et al. (2023) .
Each gate flags the answers with the lowest scores.
blocks.zh:
表5比较了在四个自由形式任务上选择哪些初始答案的门。
所有闸门使用 CAD 答案与唯一修补的相同运行,无需支持检查即可返回.
每个型号,任务和运行,四个门对初始答案进行排序,并标出与支持测试拒绝的号码相同的标志.
前两个等级以平均符号对数概率和对数概率因将通道添加到提示器而增益.
当回答模式被问及该段落是否支持其答案时,第三个使用是的概率(Kadavath等人,2022年).
第四个用途是Laurer等人(2023年)对自然语言推论进行的微调(DeBERTa-v3-group)(He等人,2023年)。
每个门都标出得分最低的答案.

blocks.en:
The self-check prompt reads “Read the passage and decide whether it supports the proposed answer to the question.”, followed by the passage, the question and the answer and by “Does the passage support the proposed answer? Reply with only yes or no.”, in the plural on HotpotQA.
The probability of yes is taken against that of no at the first token of the reply.
The entailment model reads overlapping 400-token windows of the passage as premises and takes the highest entailment probability across windows.
The hypothesis is the answer, preceded by the question when the answer has at most three words.
The closed-book gate flags the plain answers that equal the closed-book answer, 12% of the answers against 20% for the support test.
blocks.zh:
自我检查的提示是“读一下这一段,并决定它是否支持对问题的拟议答复”,然后是该段、问答,以及“该段落是否支持该拟议答复? 在HotpotQA的复数中只回答是或否。
在答复的第一个字节, " 是 " 的概率与 " 是 " 的概率相对应。
承接模式将400个门窗作为场地重叠,对窗户的承接概率最高。
假设是答案,在答案最多有三个字时,先是提问.
封闭式书门旗下平面答案等于封闭式书门的答案,12%的答案对支持测试的20%.

blocks.en:
The Mean of Table 5 averages NQ-Swap and the ordinary average.
The support test raises this Mean by 3.6 points, significantly more than the other gates, which gain at most 2.2 points.
Under the two LLM judges, its gains over sampling are 1.1 and 2.3 points, compared with at most 0.5 and 1.8 for the other gates.
Its lead over each gate is at least 0.6 points, with 95% intervals above zero.
With the self-check or the entailment model as its test, AoR stays 1.6 and 2.0 points above the closest baseline in Mean.
blocks.zh:
表5的平均值为NQ-Swap和普通平均值。
支持测试将这个平均值提高了3.6分,大大高于其他门,后者在最多2.2分时增益.
在两名LLM法官下,其比采样得分为1.1分和2.3分,而其他大门最多为0.5分和1.8分。
它在每个门上的铅至少是0.6点,间隔95%在零以上.
以自我检查或内含模型作为测试,AOR保持1.6和2.0点高于最接近的Mein基线.

blocks.en:
On the counterfactual subsets of ConFiQA, AoR gains 7.3 points over sampling, significantly more than every baseline.
Across the held-out ordinary tasks, AoR gains 1.2 points over sampling on average, while no baseline improves significantly.
On OLMo-2-13B, Yi-1.5-9B, Qwen3-32B and Llama-3.1-70B, AoR gains significantly over sampling in both groups.
Its Mean exceeds the closest baseline by 4.2, 7.1, 5.7 and 4.8 points, respectively.
Tuning every baseline on the development split of each of OLMo-2-13B, Yi-1.5-9B and Qwen3-32B leaves the closest one 4.2, 5.6 and 3.5 points behind AoR.
On the Qwen3 models of Figure 3 b, the supported answers cost the best baseline 3.7 points of its Mean at 32B, against 0.7 at 8B.
blocks.zh:
在ConFiQA的反事实子集上,AoR比采样得到7.3分,大大超过每个基准.
在整个搁置的普通任务中,AOR平均比采样增加1.2分,而基线没有显著改善。
在OLMo-2-13B,Yi-1.5-9B,Quen3-32B和Llama-3.1-70B上,AoR比两个组的采样都大有收获.
其平均值分别比最近的基线高出4.2、7.1、5.7和4.8点。
在OLMo-2-13B,Yi-1.5-9B和Quen3-32B的每个开发分裂上调整每个基线,最接近的离AoR落后一个4.2,5.6和3.5点.
在图3b的Quen3模型中,支持的答案花费了32B的平均值的3.7最佳基线点,而8B的平均值为0.7。

blocks.en: Split into quartiles by the length of the passage, AoR gains 0.8 to 9.1 points over sampling in every quartile of every free-form task, including the longest quartile of HotpotQA, whose passages have at least 1,060 words.
blocks.zh: AoR在每一次自由形式任务的每四分中,包括最长的HotpotQA的四分数中,通过长度分为四分,比采样得到0.8到9.1分,其通过数至少有1,060个字.

blocks.en:
For Table 18 , every question of NQ-Swap and NQ-Original keeps its passage and receives the passages of four other NQ-Swap questions, in the same version, that contain neither its gold answer nor its original answer as whole words.
The question’s own passage occupies a random one of the five positions, shared across its original and counterfactual versions along with the distractors.
We separate passages by blank lines and use the HotpotQA prompts.
This setting runs once, with the strengths of the main runs.
AoR scores highest on both tasks, indicating that its lead persists with the added distractors.
blocks.zh:
对于表18,NQ-Swap和NQ-Brobin的每个问题都保留它的通过,并收到其他四个NQ-Swap问题的段落,同版本,其中既不包含它的黄金答案,也不包含整个原答案.
问题本身的段落占据了五个立场中的一个随机位置,与其原始和反事实版本同分心者分享。
我们用空白的行分隔段落,使用热点QA提示.
这个设置运行一次,带有主运行的优点.
AoR在这两个任务上得分最高,表明其领先地位与新增的分散器相持.

blocks.en:
Table 19 scores a free-form answer as correct when a gold answer occurs in it as whole words after the normalization of the scorer.
For Table 20 , Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct ( Qwen Team, 2024 ) , a model outside the main comparison, judges the free-form answers with greedy decoding.
It reads “You grade answers to a reading-comprehension question. A candidate answer is correct if it means the same as one of the reference answers, even when it is worded differently, for example with an alias, an abbreviation, a number written in words, or extra words around the answer. It is wrong if it names something else or adds a claim that contradicts the references. Judge only against the references.”, followed by the question, the gold answers and the answer, and replies with yes or no.
When a method’s answer equals the plain answer of the same run after the support test’s normalization, it receives the same judgment.
Differences from sampling therefore reflect changed answers alone.
blocks.zh:
表19在计分员正常化后,当整个单词中出现黄金答案时,将自由形式答案评为正确.
对于表20, Quen2.5-32B-Instruct(Quen Team, 2024),是主比较之外的一个模型,以贪婪的解码来判断自由格式的答案.
它写道“你等级回答一个阅读理解问题。 如果一个候选答案意指与参考答案之一相同,即使其措辞不同,例如用别名,缩写,数字写成单词,或者在答案周围附加单词,则正确. 如果它点了别的东西,或者增加了与提及内容相矛盾的主张,那就是错误的。 “随后是问题、黄金答案和答案,以及回答是或否。
当一种方法的答案等于支持测试正常化后同一运行的简单答案时,它得到同样的判断。
因此,与抽样的不同仅反映了答案的变化。

blocks.en:
Among 300 random plain answers with an exact match, the judge accepts 93%, and among 300 with an F1 of zero, 8%.
The second judge, Gemma-4-31B-it ( Gemma Team, 2026 ) , reads the same prompt.
A reply counts as yes when its first word is yes.
It accepts 100% and 9% of the same two samples.

blocks.en:
We evaluate sentence answers on NQ-Swap, NQ-Original and SQuAD using the same examples and gold answers as the short-answer experiments.
We replace the format instruction in Table 8 with “Reply with one short sentence.” and allow up to 64 new tokens.
An answer is correct when a gold answer occurs in its first line as whole words after scorer normalization.
blocks.zh:
我们在NQ-Swap,NQ-原始和SQuAD上评价句子答案,使用与短答实验相同的例子和金子答案.
我们把表8的格式指示改为“以短句取代”。
当一个金子答案在计分器正常化后的第一行作为整句出现时,答案是正确的.

blocks.en:
The support test normalizes the answer’s first line and the passage as in Appendix B , then removes question words and function words from the answer.
The answer passes when at least one word remains and all remaining words occur in the passage.
Answers normalized to yes or no also pass.
We selected the requirement to match all remaining words using the development split.
We generate the closed-book answer in the same sentence format and retain the short-answer procedures for the memory veto, repairs and fallback.
blocks.zh:
支持测试使答案的第一行和附录B中的段落正常化,然后从答案中删除提问词和函数词.
当至少有一个字留下,所有剩余字句都出现在段落中时,答案就会通过.
答案通常为是或否。
我们选择了使用开发拆分来匹配所有剩余单词的要求.
我们以相同的句子格式生成闭页解答,并保留内存否决,修复和倒置的短答程序.

blocks.en: We find that AoR improves over sampling on all three tasks in Table 21 , with a larger gain on NQ-Swap than on the ordinary tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们发现AOR比表21中所有三项任务的采样有所改进,在NQ-Swap上的收益大于普通任务.

blocks.en:
We run each method once on each task for the four models in Table 22 , choosing the token with the highest score at each step.
We reselect decoder settings by the rule in Section 4 , evaluating the grid in Table 11 with greedy decoding on the four models’ development split.
The chosen strengths are 0.5 for CAD, Strict CAD and RPCD, and 1 for AdaCAD and ID.
NWCAD uses a divergence threshold of 0.1, and COIECD uses strength 1 and a constraint scale of 0.1.
AoR generates its initial answer and CAD/ID repairs greedily at these settings and reuses the sampled closed-book answer from the main runs to keep the memory veto’s reference answer fixed.
blocks.zh:
我们在表22的4个模型的每个任务上运行每个方法一次,选择每个步骤得分最高的符号.
我们用第4节的规则重新选择解码器设置,
所选的优点是:CAD、严格CAD和RPCD0.5,AdaCAD和ID1。
NWCAD使用0.1的差分阈值,COIECD使用强度1,约束尺度0.1.
AoR 生成其初始答案, CAD/ID 对这些设置进行贪婪的修复, 并重用主运行中抽取的封闭账面答案, 以固定内存否决权的参考答案 。

blocks.en:
Under greedy decoding, AoR gains 7.3 points in Mean over plain greedy decoding and outperforms the baselines on each model in Table 22 .
Together, these results suggest that AoR’s gains extend beyond short answers generated by sampling.
blocks.zh:
在贪婪的解码下,AoR在Meal比纯贪婪的解码得7.3分,并且超过了表22中每个模型的基线。
这些结果加在一起表明,AOR的收益超出了抽样产生的简短答案。
